findings.text: non-blocking: _with_comment_text duplicates with_owner_comment at reckon/nested_launch.py:908 almost line for line — the same option scan, the same three branches and the same prepend fallback differ from it only by a parameter name and two .strip() calls — and should have extended that owner rather than forking it; it does not hold the node.

non-blocking: the composed-launch case builds its own record = {"session": SESSION} and reproduces str(record.get("session") or "") in the test body, so the run-record read at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4378 is never exercised and a regression in which key that line reads would leave the case green.

non-blocking: _script_comment takes every word after --comment= on a directive line as comment text, so a script declaring "#SBATCH --comment=a --partition=b" loses --partition=b from the wrapper as well as from the command line, which silently changes the submission's partition; no script in the tree uses that form today.

non-blocking: the existing case covering find_allocations and fleet_of_allocation was left out of the gate command although the diff changes both at reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:652, so the suite that ran could not have caught a regression in the exact functions the node modified.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 65c0479b148; b3872f30fc changes the three source and test paths and 94721267f2 adds only the evidence fragment, and the whole diff is 218 added and 25 removed lines.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for tests/test_a_scheduler_job_names_its_owner.py to add one case per deliverable and for the dispatch-side case to fail when the session export is removed; the head file carries all four cases at tests/test_a_scheduler_job_names_its_owner.py:172,193,211,227 and the manifest records the declared control as 4 failed / 1 failed with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is "name the coordinator session on every job reckon submits for it"; the landed change at reckon/nested_launch.py:884-903 gives owner_comment a session-only branch, reckon/nested_launch.py:950-1000 carries a submitted script's own #SBATCH --comment beside the owner, and reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:652 keeps a fleet allocation findable once its comment gains that owner.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, both commits, 19 cases in the node file, the scoped gate at 77 passed EXIT=0 and both negative-control logs, and every rubric line is answered.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the eight declared paths against the four changed paths; reckon/nested_launch.py, reckon/crew/fleet_node.py, tests/test_a_scheduler_job_names_its_owner.py and the node's evidence fragment are all inside the declared scope, and the three declared-but-untouched files carry no diff.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_scheduler_job_names_its_owner.py:172 reddens on the owner_comment regression as measured, but tests/test_a_scheduler_job_names_its_owner.py:240 restates the record extraction the launch performs at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4378 and never exercises it.
justifications.evidence: the gate recorded in scoped-gate-1795244630841609934.log reads 77 passed EXIT=0 and both controls read red, but tests/test_a_fleet_per_project.py:114 exercises the changed reveal in reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:652 and was not run.
justifications.fit: reckon/nested_launch.py:952 follows the surrounding one-line summaries and mechanism-only comments, and no symbol carries a plan or section label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/nested_launch.py:894 names the session alone when no run exists and returns nothing only when neither is set, which is the deliverable the goal states.
justifications.reuse: reckon/nested_launch.py:984 re-implements the comment-merge scan that reckon/nested_launch.py:908 already owns in the same module.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path in the diff is a declared write path, with reckon/_backends.py, reckon/_worker_fence.py and reckon/crew/dispatch.py declared and untouched.
